title: Dalle-NFT
tagline: Use DALLE to create a NFT 1 / 1 without having to write a single line of code!
description:
This project allows creators to leverage the power of DALLE to generate artwork with nothing but text, and immediately deploy a new ERC721 contract for it to ethereum or polygon, all without a single line of code.

1. Type in a prompt
2. Generate an image for the prompt
3. One click deploy to your blockchain of choice
4. See it on opensea / other marketplaces.
how_its_made:
This project is made with alchemy, polygon, ethereum, metamask, and OpenAI API's.

Spent a lot of time making sure the UX is fairly polished, and works on a phone.

Polygon was the only sponsor relevant here, and its really great that I was able to test directly on mainnet with only a few MATIC in my wallet.
